summary: Ruling for amw8gtiazcaiqib (improvised harness). Capability: yes; 50 ft of syntherope can sling a torch and two steel bottles. But the blade is lit in Aero's right hand: tying a load-bearing harness needs both hands, so Aero must hold the lit hilt clear while knotting with one hand and teeth/elbow, or the work is clumsy. Construction: 3 minutes; Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, no proficiency on the sheet for knots, disadvantage because one hand holds a lit blade (method did not free it). DC 12 for a harness that rides; on a failure the bottles shift and the harness must be retied (still made, but loose: limits). Effectiveness: rides on his back; the bottles are heavy: running or climbing risks slipping (Dex save when he sprints), noisy (bottles knock). World check each minute: nothing approaches in this sandbox.
